note: _praestabilis_. The word is used only here in the Vulgate. A possible rendering: being above malice (_super malitia_); erhaben über Böswilligekeit (_super malitia_). Or rather: easily forgetting, conciliatory; leicht vergessend, versöhnlich. – Kaulen, p. 141.

_Virtus._ The word here refers to the “produce” of crop plants (German: “Ertrag” von Nutzpflanzen). – Kaulen, p. 33. Amos Secondary literature
